nodes.title: Session state store
nodes.purpose: Carry durable objective, graph, evidence, and churn state across turns.
nodes.mechanism: Lives on the session and gets rehydrated when the thread wakes back up.
nodes.metaphor: The map pinned to the workshop wall so nobody wanders off whistling.

nodes.title: Prompt renderer
nodes.purpose: Turn durable Epiphany state into a bounded instruction block for the agent.
nodes.mechanism: Summarizes the frontier, recent evidence, and live constraints into a compact prompt fragment.
nodes.metaphor: A folded field guide, not the whole filing cabinet.

nodes.title: Graph promoter
nodes.purpose: Promote observations and map updates into durable typed graph state.
nodes.mechanism: Validates graph patches before they enter the session state.
nodes.metaphor: The customs desk that stops counterfeit structure at the border.

nodes.title: Tool bridge
nodes.purpose: Translate model intent into tool calls without letting the prompt turn into soup.
nodes.mechanism: Binds the runtime tool surface to the working context and execution policy.
nodes.metaphor: The gearbox between intention and actual machinery.

nodes.title: Graph GUI shell
nodes.purpose: Expose architecture, dataflow, and cross-links in a browsable visual surface.
nodes.mechanism: Embeds the web viewer and routes clicks back into the rest of the application.
nodes.metaphor: The dashboard where the workshop lights stop flickering and start admitting what they power.

edges.label: bounded fragment
edges.mechanism: Session state is summarized into prompt context.

edges.label: validated updates
edges.mechanism: Promotion mutates durable state only after structural checks pass.

edges.label: tool surface
edges.mechanism: The prompt renderer reflects which tools the agent can actually use.

edges.label: typed state
edges.mechanism: The GUI consumes the same durable graph state the agent sees.

edges.label: validation status
edges.mechanism: Viewer health should expose whether the underlying graph is coherent.

nodes.title: Observations stream
nodes.purpose: Capture recent findings and raw signals before they harden into durable structure.
nodes.mechanism: Tool results and textual observations get queued as evidence inputs.
nodes.metaphor: Shavings on the floor before you decide what piece of furniture you were making.

nodes.title: Graph proposal
nodes.purpose: Stage candidate graph edits before promotion.
nodes.mechanism: Proposals carry candidate nodes, edges, and cross-links for validation.
nodes.metaphor: Wet concrete in the formwork, not the finished slab.

nodes.title: Validated graph patch
nodes.purpose: Produce a structurally safe graph update that can survive contact with persistence.
nodes.mechanism: Checks required fields, reference integrity, and duplicate IDs before promotion.
nodes.metaphor: A passport stamped by someone who actually looked at the face.

nodes.title: Epiphany state fragment
nodes.purpose: Expose the live graph frontier to the prompt without dumping the whole machine room into context.
nodes.mechanism: Summarizes only the active map and recent changes.
nodes.metaphor: A flashlight beam, not the sun.

nodes.title: Agent turn
nodes.purpose: Consume the bounded state and produce the next action, hypothesis, or patch.
nodes.mechanism: The model uses the rendered map as one constraint surface among several.
nodes.metaphor: The monkey at the lathe, but hopefully with a checklist.

edges.label: structural checks
edges.mechanism: Only well-formed graph edits get promoted.

edges.label: bounded summary
edges.mechanism: Validated graph state is summarized into promptable form.

edges.label: active map
edges.mechanism: The current state fragment shapes the next turn.

edges.label: new evidence
edges.mechanism: Actions create more observations, because life is a wheel.
